span.normalized: RWE Investco EPC MGMT, LLC filed an action, dated December 19, 2025 and served January 7, 2026, against a subsidiary of the Company and TUS, in the Superior Court of the State of California for the County of San Francisco (the “Lawsuit”) alleging breach of contract claims relating to a long-term offtake agreement. We contest the allegations and will vigorously defend against the Lawsuit and pursue all legal remedies available to the Company, including but not limited to the Cross-Complaint filed in January 2026 asserting claims against RWE Investco EPC MGMT, LLC and seeking damages, and a complaint filed in March 2026 against RWE Aktiengesellschaft in the Supreme Court of the State of New York for the County of New York, seeking to enforce their unconditional guaranty of RWE Investco EPC MGMT, LLC’s payment obligations under the long-term offtake agreement for up to $100 million.
